description.description: A medium shot of Michael Jackson standing on a sandy beach during the day. He is shirtless, wearing multi-colored swim trunks with teal, orange, and yellow blocks and white piping. Patches of vitiligo are visible on his face, arms, and hands. Other people and palm trees are visible in the soft-focus background.
